user_query: I want to raise awareness about climate change on social media. Fetch me all the news articles about climate change from various sources. Also, give me the 100 most popular combinations of keywords cited in these articles and the current headlines from Smart Curator.

TaskList.description: Fetch news articles about climate change from various news sources.
Analyze the fetched articles to extract the 100 most popular combinations of keywords.
Fetch current headlines from Smart Curator related to climate change.
